SQLQueryBuilder.select:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Build a SQL SELECT query string from the given table name, optional column list, and optional WHERE conditions." select]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> table </REF>: any "Table name to query from."
        <REF> columns </REF>: any "Columns to select; defaults to '*' and is joined with commas if not wildcard."
        <REF> where </REF>: any "Optional mapping of equality conditions to append with AND."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "A SQL SELECT query string."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND If columns is not the wildcard '*', join the column values with ', ' to form the SELECT column list. RESULT columns]
            [COMMAND Construct the base query string as SELECT followed by the resolved columns and the table name. RESULT query]
            [COMMAND If a where mapping is provided and is truthy, append a WHERE clause made from each key-value pair formatted as key='value' and joined with ' AND '. RESULT query]
            [COMMAND Return the final query string. RESULT query]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
SQLQueryBuilder.insert:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Builds an SQL INSERT statement from a table name and mapping by joining the mapping keys and quoting each value." insert]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> table </REF>: string "Target table name to insert into."
        <REF> data </REF>: mapping "Mapping whose keys become column names and whose values become inserted values."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "An SQL INSERT statement composed from the table name, comma-joined keys, and single-quoted values."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Extract the keys from the input mapping and join them into a comma-separated column list. RESULT keys]
            [COMMAND Extract the values from the input mapping, wrap each value in single quotes, and join them into a comma-separated value list. RESULT values]
            [COMMAND Format and return an SQL INSERT statement using the table name, the column list, and the value list. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
SQLQueryBuilder.delete:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Build a SQL DELETE statement for the given table and optionally append equality conditions joined by AND." delete]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> table </REF>: string "The table name to delete rows from."
        <REF> where </REF>: dictionary or null "Optional mapping of column names to values used to build the WHERE clause."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "A SQL DELETE query string."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a SQL DELETE query string starting with "DELETE FROM " followed by the table name. RESULT query]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If where is truthy, add a WHERE clause to the query.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append " WHERE " and then join each key-value pair from where.items() as "key='value'" fragments separated by " AND ". RESULT query]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
SQLQueryBuilder.update:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Build an SQL UPDATE statement from a table name, a dictionary of column values, and an optional dictionary of WHERE conditions." update]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> table </REF>: any "Table name to update."
        <REF> data </REF>: dict "Mapping of columns to new values."
        <REF> where </REF>: dict or null "Optional mapping of columns to filter rows to update."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "Constructed SQL UPDATE query string."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create the SET clause by iterating over data items and formatting each key-value pair as "key='value'", then joining the fragments with ", ". RESULT update_str]
            [COMMAND Construct the base SQL statement as "UPDATE {table} SET {update_str}" using the table name and the SET clause. RESULT query]
            [COMMAND If where is provided and is truthy, append " WHERE " followed by all where items formatted as "key='value'" and joined with " AND ". RESULT query]
            [COMMAND Return the final SQL query string. RESULT query]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
